# Result numerals typed into untagged markdown prose, as they stand today.
#
# Clause N1/N2 of `rules/notebook-standards.md`: a number appears in a figure, a table or a
# cell tagged `results`, nowhere else in prose. A value typed into a markdown cell does not
# move when the notebook is re-executed, so the sentence and the output beside it disagree and
# nothing can see that they do.
#
# These sites are listed rather than fixed, on Stefan's ruling of 2026-09-11 that introduced
# the clause: apply it to whatever notebook is open and to anything written from now on, and
# leave a violation alone in a notebook nobody is otherwise touching. The fix - compute the
# value into the cell instead of typing it - is a code-cell change that costs a re-execution.
# Listing them gates the rule against NEW ones at no re-execution cost.
#
# HOW TO USE THIS FILE: when you re-execute one of these notebooks for any reason, move its
# numbers into the figure, the table or a `results` cell and delete the line. The list may only
# shrink. A count that is now lower than the listed one fails too, so a partial fix must lower
# the count here rather than leave it.
#
# Regenerate a single file's rows with:
#   python .github/scripts/check_prose_numerals.py <path>
#
# <path>\t<numeral>\t<count>
